resources.string: Send content to the AI service?

To run this feature, content from your document (the selected text, the page text or the file text, or a page image when needed) will be sent to the AI service: %1$s.\n\nThis content leaves your device and is processed on that service\'s servers. Nothing is sent if you tap Cancel. You can withdraw consent at any time in Settings → AI.
Nothing was sent: you did not allow sharing content with the AI service.
When off, you will be asked before any document content is sent
